about_short_description.short_description: Recurse Center is an independent educational institution, combining a retreat for computer programmers with a recruiting agency.

product.name: Recurse Center Retreat
product.description: A self-directed, full-time programming retreat lasting six or twelve weeks, designed for programmers to focus on personal growth and skill development.

product.name: Career Services
product.description: Personalized career support including job recommendations, referrals, mock interviews, and negotiation assistance for Recursers and alumni.

product.name: Recruiting Agency
product.description: A recruiting service connecting partner companies with qualified Recursers for programming roles, charging fees only upon successful hires.

product.name: Brooklyn Hub
product.description: A physical workspace in Brooklyn offering 24/7 access to Recursers with facilities for focused work, collaboration, hardware projects, and social interaction.
